exposure: vaginal bleeding during the second trimester
Vaginal bleeding during the second trimester
cohort: 92 women with circumvallate placenta who delivered live singletons at a tertiary care center between January 2000 and September 2012, compared with 9057 controls
finding: Circumvallate placenta was associated with higher incidences of preterm delivery, placental abruption, emergency cesarean section, small-for-gestational age, neonatal death, neonatal intensive care unit admission, and chronic lung disease.
mod_finding: Women with circumvallate placenta were more likely to have emergency cesarean sections compared to controls.
